protocol.pairing: Alternating order, one persistent prepared VM per mode; cold construction/preparation reported separately.
protocol.warmPolicy: First execution plus configured warmup pairs are retained and excluded from measured summaries.
protocol.gc: Exposed host GC before each complete warm observation; managed GC stays inside guest execution. Explicit pool/root correctness collections and array verification are outside their respective timers.
protocol.memory: Managed and frame allocation counters are exact; process host-memory fields are gauges, never allocation totals.
protocol.scope: Same-host JavaScript VM qualification. Reduced differential counts or array sizes remain explicitly partial.
